meta.attribution: Indeholder data fra Klimadatastyrelsen, Danmarks Adresseregister (DAR)
meta.notes: Datafordeleren's anonymous daily current extract; one row per husnummer (access address), so floor and door addresses are not read; husnumre with status nedlagt (4) or henlagt (5) excluded, foreløbig (2) kept; id is the husnummer id_lokalId; point is its adgangspunkt, EPSG:25832 transformed to EPSG:4326 with pyproj; points with nøjagtighedsklasse U (not placed at the address) marked estimated; house_number is husnummertekst; road is the full vejnavn; city is the postnummer navn, supplerende bynavn not used
meta.draw: lowest sha256('2026:' || register id) among eligible rows

forms.messy: same, without postcode, region and country, abbreviated by OpenCage's lists

meta.truth: the register's point, converted to WGS84 by PROJ where the register uses another CRS
